hard_gate: Prove a material end-to-end critical-path Oracle upper bound on a near-real serving DAG, trace, or workload model before designing a GPU action or runtime mechanism.

candidates.name: Exact Action-Surface Existence Certificate
candidates.definition: Compile each MoE serving action into decision-visible state, mutable object, deleted dependency, downstream propagation, and fully charged cost; quotient equivalent actions and measure full-request-DAG headroom.
candidates.current_evidence: Exploratory and unrun standalone; BCRD formal Gate 2 remains INVALID_REQUEST_DAG_REPLAY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
candidates.novelty_risk: High; scheduling DSL, causal simulators, and action-equivalence work are close.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: On one identity-complete full DAG, exhaustively enumerate assignment, bounded seal, admission, and release under identical arrivals, routes, and measured service surfaces; require dependency-deletion certificates, replay closure, and all costs.
candidates.positive_means: At least one non-anticipative, semantics-preserving class retains >=10% net full-DAG headroom.
candidates.negative_freeze: All classes below 10%, or gain requiring future leakage, zero cost, or semantic change, returns ACTION_SPACE_ABSENT.
candidates.resources: CPU exact enumeration plus RTX-5090 service qualification; optimized multi-GPU EP only for formal communication claims.

candidates.name: Non-Anticipative MoE Oracle Leakage Certificate
candidates.definition: Separate clairvoyant Oracle gain from realizable non-anticipative headroom by identical observable prefixes, hidden suffixes, and a timestamped read ledger.
candidates.current_evidence: Generation-only candidate with no pilot; prior same-family jury marked CAUTION.
candidates.novelty_risk: Medium-high; generic scheduling leakage audits are close.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Freeze decision timestamps and the full-DAG evaluator, mask next-layer routes, future decode routes, output length, and future arrivals, and require detection of an injected illegal future field.
candidates.positive_means: >=5% clairvoyant-versus-non-anticipative headroom gap or repeatable action reversals.
candidates.negative_freeze: >95% action agreement and <5% net-headroom difference in all natural cells, or failure to detect injected leakage.
candidates.resources: CPU paired-suffix replay plus RTX-5090 service measurements; optimized multi-GPU serving for formal proof.

candidates.name: Route-Conditioned Barrier Amplification Boundary
candidates.definition: Hold work and natural routes fixed, replay real top-k barriers, a no-barrier counterfactual, and a route-decorrelated control, then attribute only unhidden full-request completion/SLO changes to the MoE barrier.
candidates.current_evidence: Exploratory and unpiloted; current authority keeps the natural expert-pressure phenomenon Gate open while the full request DAG and denominator remain missing.
candidates.novelty_risk: High; broad imbalance/barrier scheduling is crowded, so the residual must be a cross-model boundary beyond max-load or CV.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Use two models, natural continuous-decode routes, identity-complete full DAGs, measured service surfaces, and a matched denominator; compare real-barrier, no-barrier, and decorrelated replays with identical work.
candidates.positive_means: A common natural regime retains >=10% full-request Oracle space and a stable MoE-specific boundary beyond simple predictors.
candidates.negative_freeze: All common natural cells below 5%, actionability below 20%, or simple max-load/CV matching the boundary freezes the standalone direction.
candidates.resources: CPU replay plus one RTX 5090 for route/service qualification; optimized multi-GPU EP for formal communication claims.

candidates.name: Joint-Intervention Deduplicated Exposure Ledger
candidates.definition: Measure fragmentation, route-conditioned straggler, and HoL on one full request DAG with exact subset interventions so overlapping critical-path savings are unioned rather than summed.
candidates.current_evidence: Unrun and previously retained only as a supporting accounting module.
candidates.novelty_risk: Medium-high; generic critical-path attribution and Shapley profiling are close.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Run exactly eight replays on the same identity-complete trace: empty, three singles, three pairs, and the union; close conservation and report union, overlap, interaction, and order sensitivity.
candidates.positive_means: The deduplicated union remains >=10% and exposes a stable minimal MoE dependency set.
candidates.negative_freeze: Union below the gate or attribution-order instability freezes controller selection from these factors.
candidates.resources: CPU exact replay plus RTX-5090 route/service qualification; multi-GPU only for physical EP validation.

candidates.name: Placement Calibration Half-Life vs Reconfiguration Break-Even
candidates.definition: Compare the predictive lifetime of route-derived demand calibration with fully charged placement reconfiguration costs propagated through request completion, queue spillover, and batch retirement.
candidates.current_evidence: Exploratory and unrun; no formal multi-GPU migration evidence.
candidates.novelty_risk: High; drift and reconfiguration have many direct neighbors.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Use document-disjoint past/future windows and compare stay-put, periodic, detector-triggered, and offline dynamic Oracle under identical replica/HBM budgets and measured copy, barrier, and spillover costs.
candidates.positive_means: Across models, predictable half-life exceeds break-even and the charged Oracle retains >=10% end-to-end headroom.
candidates.negative_freeze: Half-life shorter than break-even or charged Oracle below 10% freezes dynamic placement.
candidates.resources: CPU replay and RTX-5090 route/service qualification; optimized multi-GPU EP for real migration costs.

candidates.name: QuantumYield Full-DAG
candidates.definition: Allow one bounded cooperative yield in a running expert batch, preserve completed work, run a newly revealed join-closing sibling, and resume the exact remainder with a positive penalty.
candidates.current_evidence: No direct evidence; CriticalSplit and JoinStream do not test preempt/resume, and their results cannot be reused as support.
candidates.novelty_risk: High; cooperative GPU preemption and persistent-kernel yielding are generic neighbors.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Add PREEMPT/RESUME to the full-DAG CPU replay, at most once per batch, with exact work conservation and positive resume costs; compare against clairvoyant WHOLE+HOLD.
candidates.positive_means: A positive-cost running-state transition strictly improves full-request flow and is actually selected by the Oracle.
candidates.negative_freeze: WHOLE+HOLD matching the expanded Oracle at positive penalty freezes this formulation.
candidates.resources: CPU exact replay only for the opportunity Gate.

candidates.name: OpenBatch Lifecycle Oracle
candidates.definition: Overlap a positive launch-setup/open phase with later same-key row revelation, then close membership and execute atomically.
candidates.current_evidence: No direct evidence; CriticalSplit HOLD cannot append after launch, but another subset launch or row-ready event would be a disqualified isomorph.
candidates.novelty_risk: High; adaptive rebatching and asynchronous micro-queues are strong neighbors.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Add OPEN/APPEND/CLOSE/COMPUTE to the full-DAG replay with positive setup cost and complete wait/service accounting; compare against future-known WHOLE+HOLD.
candidates.positive_means: Actual APPEND use strictly improves full-request flow when setup is nonzero and terminal work is identical.
candidates.negative_freeze: Every OPEN trajectory equivalent to delayed WHOLE, or no gain with positive setup, freezes the contract.
candidates.resources: CPU exact replay only for the opportunity Gate.

candidates.name: HedgeJoin First-Completion
candidates.definition: Duplicate one late join-closing contribution, atomically commit the first exact completion, and charge all duplicate, cancellation, serialization, and resource work.
candidates.current_evidence: No request-level evidence; deterministic simulators omit stochastic tails and JoinStream's natural overlap yielded 0/4 safe-benefit cells.
candidates.novelty_risk: Very high; request hedging and speculative execution are mature.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Replay locked empirical service samples through a full request DAG; compare no hedge and best fixed hedge against a one-hedge Oracle with full costs and no injected delay.
candidates.positive_means: Measured variability creates full-request join-closing value beyond a fixed hedge.
candidates.negative_freeze: Gains disappear after costs or are captured by a fixed hedge.
candidates.resources: CPU replay over existing timing samples; no GPU for the opportunity Gate.

candidates.name: ShapeLease Critical-Path Tactic Residency
candidates.definition: Keep whole membership fixed but let each executor retain one semantic-equivalent tactic and pay explicit costs to switch among tactics for later waves.
candidates.current_evidence: Universal fixed-C8 is frozen at NO_GO_D10_HEADLINE_COST; correctness and isolated tactic timings are kernel-local, not positive full-request evidence.
candidates.novelty_risk: Very high; without a full-DAG residual this is kernel autotuning.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Freeze existing measured service tables and positive reconfiguration costs; compare adaptive replay with the best of all fixed-tactic exact Oracles on complete request episodes.
candidates.positive_means: Adaptive tactic residency strictly improves request completion, uses at least two tactics, and closes all costs under one semantic contract.
candidates.negative_freeze: Best fixed tactic matches adaptive, switching is unused, or gains require zero switch cost.
candidates.resources: CPU exact replay using existing surfaces; no new kernel implementation for the Oracle Gate.

candidates.name: ShadowCommit Route-Barrier Repair
candidates.definition: After native expert execution, use an execution-after route-barrier signal to commit when safe or replay a sealed canonical suffix before the next dependent DAG node.
candidates.current_evidence: StableBatch fresh Oracle was positive, but static/online pre-action selectors and the newer sparse-C8 ridge failed; there is no end-to-end timing evidence.
candidates.novelty_risk: Very high; verify/rollback and selective repair are direct neighbors.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Join the frozen outcome ledger to a full request-DAG timing replay with sealed verify/checkpoint/repair costs; compare native, always canonical, always verify, fixed trigger, and execution-after Oracle.
candidates.positive_means: Selective repair beats always-canonical and always-verify at request level after duplicate compute and state costs.
candidates.negative_freeze: The upper bound is critical-path dominated, requires near-full replay, or cannot beat simple always policies.
candidates.resources: Offline CPU ledger join and full-DAG replay; no GPU for the initial Gate.

candidates.name: SemanticFence-v2 End-to-End Qualification
candidates.definition: Before building a semantic packer, test whether a future-known semantic-safe M2 packing Oracle on fresh natural continuous-decode rows changes full-request completion while preserving the frozen downstream semantic boundary.
candidates.current_evidence: Reused-calibration semantic shadow reports a 26.20% additive expert-stage projection, but exact natural M2 projection is 3.40%; neither is fresh, end-to-end, or serving evidence.
candidates.novelty_risk: High; safe batching, verification, and numerical-stability controls are crowded, and the current online selector already failed.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: On fresh pre-outcome document-disjoint continuous-decode traces, build an identity-complete full request DAG and compare all-M1/native with a future-known semantics-preserving M1/M2 assignment under measured packing, waiting, dispatch, and fallback costs; do not train a selector.
candidates.positive_means: The charged Oracle retains >=10% full-request headroom while preserving the sealed route/top-k or stronger semantic contract.
candidates.negative_freeze: Net full-request headroom below 5%, no natural eligible rows, or benefit only from enriched/reused calibration freezes SemanticFence-v2 as a paper mechanism.
candidates.resources: CPU full-DAG replay plus one RTX 5090 for fresh route/output and service qualification; multi-GPU only for later serving validation.

candidates.name: Optimized EP Return-Path Existence Gate
candidates.definition: Measure whether optimized expert-return traffic remains on the request critical path under real EP serving before revisiting any receiver-aware representation or scheduling action.
candidates.current_evidence: NOT_TESTED_REQUIRES_8XA100; single-GPU MoE time contains no return all-to-all, and fixed RankLane is already NO-GO for p_return <=20%.
candidates.novelty_risk: Medium as a measurement result but high as a standalone method; optimized EP systems already target return overlap and fusion.
candidates.minimum_oracle_gate: Run natural arrivals on optimized 8xA100 EP with request-level TPOT/P99/goodput and same-clock precedence-DAG deletion of return traffic; bind bytes, rank identities, transport, and the full denominator.
candidates.positive_means: Exposed return fraction reaches the recorded 23.5294% reopen condition and a zero-tax Oracle exceeds 5% end-to-end headroom.
candidates.negative_freeze: All common natural cells below 5% or exposed return fraction below the reopen condition permanently keeps receiver-aware mechanisms frozen.
candidates.resources: Optimized 8xA100 EP serving stack; not answerable on one RTX 5090.
